text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind the school building, I caught sight 
of Sweep Tosho up to something suspicious.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little scared, but I'll give it a 
shot... The forbidden magic...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"According to the grimoire, it's a giant 
dragon capable of crushing an entire small 
town with ease—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"If I summon that, anyone would be 
surprised and do whatever I say...!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna threaten my Trainer into letting 
me skip the race!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems running consecutive races has 
pushed her to her limits. I need to 
rethink her schedule...
